title: ADR-0010 — Multi-Tenancy Architecture Strategy Rules
description: Machine-readable rules encoding ADR-0010 Multi-Tenancy Architecture. Conditional rules for products serving multiple tenants with dual-layer filtering.
condition: REQUIRED when product serves multiple tenants. Single-tenant products may defer.

rules.title: Application-layer tenant filtering is primary
rules.description: Application-layer filtering (WHERE tenant_id = X) is the PRIMARY enforcement mechanism for tenant data isolation. Every query that returns tenant-owned data MUST include tenant_id filter.
rules.rationale: ADR-0010: Application-layer filtering as primary mechanism. Always filter by tenant context.
rules.validationQuery: All repository queries include tenant_id in WHERE clause. No raw queries that bypass application context.

rules.title: Database-native tenant enforcement is secondary
rules.description: Database-native enforcement (RLS policies, separate schemas) is the SECONDARY failsafe mechanism. Database enforcement supplements but does not replace application-layer filtering.
rules.rationale: ADR-0010: Dual-layer strategy. Database is failsafe, not primary.
rules.validationQuery: Database has RLS or schema-per-tenant. Application-layer filtering still enforced even when DB enforcement exists.

rules.title: Tenant context propagated through all layers
rules.description: Tenant context (tenant_id) MUST be propagated through all layers without exception. Domain logic operates with explicit tenant context. No implicit tenant assumption.
rules.rationale: ADR-0010: Tenant context must be explicit and immutable for the duration of the request.
rules.validationQuery: TenantId passed as explicit parameter or via scoped context (not static). Domain methods signature includes tenant context.

rules.title: Cross-tenant data access prohibited
rules.description: Cross-tenant data access is strictly prohibited. No query, report, or export operation may access data from multiple tenants without explicit multi-tenant authorization.
rules.rationale: ADR-0010: Data isolation is non-negotiable. Cross-tenant access requires explicit corporate authorization.
rules.validationQuery: Audit logs verify no cross-tenant queries. Access control lists block cross-tenant operations.

rules.title: Multi-tenant schema strategy defined upfront
rules.description: The multi-tenant schema strategy (shared schema with tenant_id, separate schema per tenant, or separate database per tenant) MUST be defined before Phase 2 Design and documented in evolith.yaml.
rules.rationale: ADR-0010: Schema strategy affects all bounded contexts. Must be decided early.
rules.validationQuery: evolith.yaml specifies boundedContexts[].persistence strategy (shared-schema | schema-per-tenant | db-per-tenant).

rules.title: Tenant-scoped audit trail maintained
rules.description: All tenant operations MUST be logged with tenant context. Audit trail enables compliance and security investigation per tenant.
rules.rationale: ADR-0010: Audit trail must be tenant-scoped for compliance and security.
rules.validationQuery: All audit logs include tenant_id field. Logs are immutable and retained per compliance requirements.

rules.title: Tenant migration path defined for schema changes
rules.description: When schema changes affect tenant data (new tenant column, migration scripts), the migration MUST include tenant-aware rollback and validation. No schema migration that breaks tenant data integrity.
rules.rationale: ADR-0010: Schema migrations in multi-tenant context are high-risk. Tenant data integrity must be preserved.
rules.validationQuery: Migration scripts include tenant validation tests. Rollback tested with tenant data present.

rules.title: External APIs validate tenant context on every request
rules.description: Every API endpoint that handles tenant data MUST validate tenant context from authentication token or header. Requests without valid tenant context are rejected with 403 Forbidden.
rules.rationale: ADR-0010: API endpoints must enforce tenant context at the boundary.
rules.validationQuery: API middleware validates tenant_id from JWT/token on every request. Invalid tenant context returns 403.

schemaStrategies.description: All tenants share same database schema with tenant_id column
Each tenant has own PostgreSQL schema

schemaStrategies.useWhen: High sensitivity, low tenant count, strong isolation required

exitCriteria.description: All tenant-scoped queries include tenant_id filter. Database RLS enforced. Tenant context propagated through all layers.
